# Frozen target cohort reviewed; stage inputs and request its slot

Root read the frozen target plan47eff19d/readiness30b71f53/runner648a9e2f and helper/layout host checks. The bounded two-engine cohort and six alternating rounds/five requested RENDER completions per arm are appropriate; timing remains whole foreground RUN/reply, not native CCOUNT or physical rendering. Keep primary images/control/oracles exact, no diagnostic entry added.

You may now deploy the frozen harness/packages/oracles to your owned Oryx ignored tree, independently verify external rows-r1/ELF/stable086 pins there, and prepare a NEW stopped canonical qualification profile if your local workflow needs one. Preserve the accepted review and every existing runtime/profile. Your plan correctly targets supplied x86 Oryx first; pending ARM input must not be substituted or used. The separate FSIM Pi-first dependency does not itself impose a new Wolf policy; follow your actual local instructions. No emulator instantiation while staging.

When fully pinned, submit ONE central request for exactly two fresh sequential JIT/interpreter qualification processes, same finite bounds and first-failure stop. Source/profile/runtime receipt plus actual command/output paths precede root's fresh grant. Generation23 currently belongs to6502's two bounded origin observations; wait for release/grant, no self-grant or expiry. Qualified human review staging and fullMOS rehearsal stay conditional later work after both receipts, as frozen in your plan. No GUI/hardware/publication; no new human attention request.
